Program & Department Contacts
The Vanderbilt Graduate School confers Ph.D., M.A., M.S., M.F.A. and M.L.A.S. degrees in programs that are either focused in a specific academic department or are custom-designed to draw from faculty across two or more academic units.
Who to Contact
Select a program or department below to visit their graduate program website.
For more specific information, questions, and admissions-related inquiries, contact the program manager listed below. Additionally, the Director of Graduate Studies (DGS) for each program will assist admitted students by acting as a liaison to the Graduate School and providing guidance on items of importance like orientation, registration, transfer of credits, records, professional development, funding opportunities, and more.
